section_summary.extract_value: This section presents exploratory factor analysis (EFA) results for the BAS-2 (Body Appreciation Scale-2) conducted on a female sample. Bartlett's test and KMO measures confirmed the correlation matrix was suitable for factor analysis, and the analysis revealed that a single dominant factor should be extracted, explaining 48.8% of total item variance, with all items loading adequately onto this factor.
